subject: Architecture handover & integration deep-dive — reschedule options
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed architecture handover (Jun 10)

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks again for the quick call yesterday — we'd like to lock in a follow-up so your team can do a technical handover for our integration team. Proposed slot: Wed, Jun 10 at 10:00 AM PT (45 min).

High-level agenda:
- 0-10m: introductions & success criteria
- 10-30m: architecture walkthrough (network, auth, model variants)
- 30-40m: integration checklist & data flow
- 40-45m: next steps / owners

Attendees: Jordan (integration lead), Sanjay (security), Karthik, Laura.
I attached a brief that summarizes our current infra and the integration scope (acme-arch-brief.pdf).

If that slot works I'll send a calendar invite. If not, propose a couple alternatives and include any pre-reqs you need.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Lee
Integration Lead, Acme Retail

(attachment: acme-arch-brief.pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed architecture handover (Jun 10)

Jordan — thanks for this and for the brief. Jun 10 at 10:00 AM PT works for me.

Looping in Monica (Solutions Engineer) who will own the integration checklist and run the demo. Laura will cover model/serving details. Two quick asks before the handover:
- Can Sanjay share the IP / egress constraints and whether you plan to use an existing VPC peering or a private endpoint?
- Any sample request/response sizes you expect (tokens / batch sizes) so we can show representative perf numbers?

Agenda tweak suggestion: add a 5 minute demo of the live routing/fallback behavior at 25-30m.

If you like, we can record the session and share slides. I'll await the calendar invite.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Product Manager, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Quick note — we missed the handover

Jordan / Sanjay — we were on the call at 10:00 AM PT but it looks like you weren't able to join. No problem — things happen.

Options to move forward: please pick one of the slots below and I'll send an invite. All times PT:
- Thu, Jun 11 — 9:00 AM or 1:00 PM
- Fri, Jun 12 — 11:00 AM
- Mon, Jun 15 — 10:00 AM

If those don't work, propose 2-3 windows and we'll adapt.

If there's an outage on your side and you want a short recorded walk-through + slides instead of live, we can record a 20-minute recording and follow with an asynchronous Q&A.

Also attaching the updated slide deck we'll use for the deep-dive (updated-deep-dive-slides.pdf).

Looking forward to getting this scheduled — Monica will run the demo and take ownership of the integration checklist once we confirm.

Thanks,
Karthik
(attachment: updated-deep-dive-slides.pdf)

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick note — we missed the handover

Hi Karthik — so sorry about the no-show. We had an unexpected maintenance window in our primary data center that pulled Sanjay into an incident response; I should have given a heads up. Really appreciate the flexible options.

Let's take Thu, Jun 11 at 1:00 PM PT if that works for Monica and Laura.

Two items for the session so we can be prepared:
1) Sanjay asked to see the audit/logging options and how token-level tracing looks in the Console.
2) We need a one-page checklist for our procurement team (SOW/contacts, expected costs, any cross-account networking steps).

I'll accept the calendar invite once you send it. Also cc'ing our procurement contact separately after this thread.

Apologies again — appreciate your patience.

Best,
Jordan

Prep items: Monica and I will prepare the one-page procurement checklist (SOW bullets, expected throughput/cost ranges, KMS options) and Laura will pull the Console audit screenshots for token-level tracing.
